title: Cimmino
description: cimmino.com Manifattura Foderami Cimmino is an Italian wholesale fabric distributor based in Naples with roots dating back to 1750, making it one of the oldest textile companies in Europe, now run by the Cimmino family, CEO Fabio Cimmino and CFO Antonio Cimmino. Operating from the CIS Nola wholesale hub, the largest distribution center in Europe, it stocks over 10 million meters of fabric and more than 1,000 fabric types, shipping worldwide within 48 hours through two in house quality labs. Its seven product lines cover linings, ready to wear fashion, bridal and ceremony, dance and events, carnival and party, bed and table linen including the Bellora brand, and upholstery, plus niche church vestment and medical fabrics. Clients include top fashion brands, linen designers and thousands of retailers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and the company exhibits at Milan Unica and Messe Frankfurt textile fairs. Revenue stands at about 11.6 million euro in 2025 with 31 employees.
